Job Description: 
 
 Are you an early-career software developer looking for an opportunity to build your technical skills while working on real-world applications?
  
 CSI is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our development team in Paducah, Kentucky. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or junior developer who wants to begin or grow a career in software development while gaining hands-on experience with C#, SQL, JavaScript, APIs, and banking technology .
  
 You’ll work alongside experienced developers who can help you learn CSI's applications, development processes, and tools. Most of your time will be spent coding, with additional opportunities to troubleshoot applications, work through support requests, test changes, and collaborate with Product Management and other teams.
  
 This is a hybrid position based in Paducah , where many members of the team are located. Having the team nearby will provide additional opportunities for hands-on training, mentoring, and collaboration as you get up to speed.
   
 What You'll Do 
 Spend approximately 75% of your time coding and developing application enhancements 
 Develop and maintain applications using C#, SQL, and JavaScript 
 Write, test, debug, and maintain code under the guidance of experienced developers 
 Assist with enhancements and ongoing development for CSI's banking applications 
 Troubleshoot production issues and respond to application-related support requests 
 Work with Product Management, CRC, and internal stakeholders to research questions and resolve application issues 
 Write and execute functional test scenarios 
 Identify and resolve straightforward software bugs, escalating more complex issues when appropriate 
 Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from experienced developers 
 Contribute to sprint planning, team meetings, and development discussions 
 Learn CSI's products, development tools, processes, and banking applications 
 Participate in occasional post-release testing, currently occurring approximately six times per year 
   
 Technologies You'll Work With 
 Primary technologies: 
 C# 
 .NET 
 SQL 
 JavaScript 
   
 Experience or exposure to the following is a plus, but not required: 
 Angular 
 API development 
 Postman 
 Swagger 
 Hangfire 
 Telerik controls 
  
  Candidates do not need to come in knowing every technology listed above. This is an early-career role designed for someone who has a solid technical foundation and is excited to continue learning.
   
 Applications You'll Support 
 You'll have an opportunity to work with several applications supporting CSI's banking customers, including solutions focused on:
 Document storage and retrieval 
 Bank and executive reporting 
 Data processing and database integration 
 Telephone banking 
 Other internally developed banking applications 
 
 One of the primary areas of focus will be Centerdoc, CSI's document storage solution. You'll provide additional development capacity and backup support while gaining deeper knowledge of the application.
   
 What We're Looking For 
 0–3 years of hands-on experience in software development or a related technical field 
 Education or training from an accredited university, college, trade school, or comparable technical program 
 Foundational knowledge of software development concepts 
 Experience or coursework involving C#, SQL, and/or JavaScript 
 Ability to troubleshoot problems and work through technical issues 
 Willingness to ask questions, accept feedback, and learn from more experienced developers 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills 
 Interest in building a long-term career in software development 
  
 Coursework, internships, personal projects, and early professional development experience may all be relevant for this position.
   
 Work Environment 
  
 This role is based in Paducah, Kentucky and will follow a hybrid work model , with approximately 1–2 days per week in the office , particularly during onboarding and training.
   
 Grow Your Career at CSI 
 This position is designed for someone at the beginning of their software development career. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers, work on applications used by financial institutions, and gradually take on greater technical ownership as your skills and product knowledge grow.
  
 CSI developers also have access to AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude as supplemental resources for activities such as understanding or analyzing code. AI-generated output is expected to be reviewed and validated rather than used as a replacement for software development knowledge and judgment.
 As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit www.csiweb.com   
 
 CSI provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for our employees. When determining your pay, we consider various factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience and location. Along with a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for incentive awards based on both individual and business performance. We also offer a comprehensive range of benefits. To learn more about our benefits, visit: Benefits Summary 
 
 CSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email us at recruiter@csiweb.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
 
 For applicants residing in California, please read Privacy Notice for California Residents | CSI (csiweb.com) 
 
 Visa Sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.
